rules: Only the parent launches the application. All resources are disposable local fixtures.
take(name, ctx) returns setup data and cleanup(); register cleanup immediately.
Browser actions and assertions stay in case source. No fixture.run or assertion booleans.
Each fixture is isolated by invocation/actor. Cleanup uses exact public resources; uncertain creation remains in custody.
Unavailable fixture or required variant throws shared runner Blocked. Never fabricate an observation.
Never place credentials in evidence; authentication field values are used only in Playwright fill.
Write ingress ctx.am; switchAM(otherAM(ctx.am)) preserves session and reads via peer. Parent browser.evidence(page) proves actual ingress/owner/request.
account-authentication MUST use real browser_session; bearer injection is not a sign-in/sign-out proof.
task-machine MUST be BLOCKED at take until actual desktop WebSocket upgrades and rendered frames work through the proxy.
Runtime events below are normalized from the real local runtime/worker journal, not a fabricated model or precomputed PASS flag.
Prepared transcript fits one public page (no next); otherwise supply a smaller fresh fixture. All resources remain local and disposable.

browser.open: ({actor:'user', am:'a'|'b', agentId?}) -> {page: real Playwright Page, origin, switchAM(am), close()}
browser.evidence: (page) -> multi-am-browser-evidence-v1 {real_ui, compiled_source, compiled_manifest, secrets_redacted, authentication, requests:[{method,am,request_id,agent_id_sha256,owner_stable,owner_epoch}]}. Agent peer reads must actually reach both AMs, not merely change selectedAm.

account-preferences.setup: Isolated signed-in user, clipboard read/write granted, compiled web manifest independently supplied.

data.session: already-open, artifact/identity-verified real browser session; case reuses it

account-authentication.setup: Two isolated real local NyxID accounts. user initially authenticated; no active work. Known private resource and foreign sentinel. Real login fields remain private.

navigation-hierarchy.setup: Owned Sandbox/Workspace/Agent hierarchy plus foreign/deleted/retired sentinels, local one-shot navigation read failure control. Scope fixtures include viewer and writable scope. Expected rows derive from setup manifest.

faults.failNextNavigationRead: async function: fail exactly one real inventory read; no synthetic success

navigation-inventory.setup: Personal disposable inventory with >50 rows to exercise next/previous, task-created and channel-created provenance; exhaustive offered filter options and independently computed expected IDs/labels.

filterGroups.label: Creation origin | Agent status | Channel activity

task-draft.setup: Two user sessions and two task locations; no admitted work; mutable draft data and distinct location path.

data.otherLocationPath: fresh public Sandbox URL; case opens More actions -> New agent to reach the location-scoped draft
data.otherSession: separate subject verified real browser session; case reuses it

task-create.setup: Policy allows task creation, empty workspace defaults, harmless deterministic runtime, capacity. install capture/custody before browser opens, including unknown admission requests.

data.custody: async function(receipt): retain exact admission/resource IDs

task-machine.setup: Verified desktop image, actual Linux desktop/Chromium with frame receipt; optional explicitly forbidden capability variant.

desktop.observe: async function(agentId): raw frame sequence/digest/dimensions, actual runtime identity and Chromium presence

task-manual.setup: Local task_home_admission disabled through public supported configuration; manual creation available; cleanup restores policy.

faults.dropObservationAfterAdmission: async function: sever browser observation after actual POST accepted; retain request/operation identity
faults.cutReceipt: async function -> {accepted:true, operationId, agentId, idempotencyKey} from actual accepted POST before dropped observation

limits.prepare: async function -> {cleanup}; fills only disposable capacity via public API; cleanup idempotent after release

displayedLimits: exact configured capacity text visible at setup route

invalidInputs.path: real New Sandbox/Agent or repository route

agent-ready.setup: Disposable ready Agent with completed known history and deterministic runtime including real tool execution; independent second account cannot read it. Message fixture emits a real streaming chunk and tool progress then holds; longMessage starts bounded barrier until interrupt; secondMessage runs to completion. Per-variant isolated Agent means journal has no unrelated starts.

data.longMessage: bounded turn held by real runtime barrier

runtime.releaseTurn: async function: release actual runtime barrier
runtime.effects: async function -> ordered raw normalized events [{agentId,type:start|terminal|cancel|effect|approval_answer|approval_cancel,turnSequence,input?,name?,approvalId?,decision?}]; same Agent only; effect counts are asserted in cases

data.toolProgressText: exact actual runtime tool progress text, held while streaming until releaseTurn

faults.pauseQueueObservation: async function: pause only browser queue/event reads so an editor can race real worker dispatch; no success stubbing

faults.cutReceipt: async function -> {accepted:true,commandId,responseId,key} joined to actual accepted command

agent-suggestions.setup: First offered suggestion equals data.suggestion; real runtime suggestions projection, initial draft retained, chosen appended input completes after barrier release.

agent-quick-messages.setup: Agent actually created by a local Trigger carrying quick_messages.

data.draft: unique existing composer draft to preserve

agent-copy.setup: Ready Agent with one final answer containing one code block, no deliverable markup; exact visible text and raw answer content agree; clipboard permissions enabled.

agent-public-ready.setup: Fresh owned Sandbox/empty Workspace/Agent via public APIs. Exact lifecycle ID joins the Agent; exact unique initial message reaches one completed durable transcript turn. No deterministic streaming/provider fixture required. Agent bootstrap is a transient Starting-only field and is not required on Ready.

data.agentName: submitted name (not an invented public Agent.name field)
data.historyText: actual submitted unique owner message, confirmed in completed public transcript
data.cleanup: exact owner/name-checked public Sandbox retirement plus independent child/operation finality

navigation-tasks.setup: agent-public-ready plus actual outsider-owned private Sandbox and denied direct read by user. Public Workspace projection confirms completed task. Real one-shot read fault only armed by case step.

data.agent: public Agent plus Completed label from task_status=completed projection

faults.failNextNavigationRead: arm the parent real GET fault; cleanup restores it once

data.cleanup: both public Sandbox retirements and both real browser sessions

routing_base: f5d2d08d3: explicit ctx.request am is honored; browser reads follow switchAM while writes route to live non-owner. Cases derive peer from actual last write AM.

compiledWeb.source: independent compiled web source: full 40 lowercase hex
compiledWeb.manifestSha256: independent compiled web artifact manifest sha256:<64 hex> matching browser adapter
compiledWeb.buildInfoSha256: independent SHA256 of emitted build-info.json bytes: bare 64 hex

user.subject: independently known real local NyxID subject

outsider.subject: different real local NyxID subject; required for task-draft/navigation-tasks

userResources.timeout_ms: optional integer 2000..300000; default240000; polling never faster than2s
userResources.reserve: async({purpose,caseId})->{parent_cleanup_barrier:true,retainIntent,retainResource,release}. Exclusive per-case custody. Parent owns lease if setup fails or outcome is unknown.
userResources.retainIntent: async({kind,actor,am,method,path,key,body,parentId?}); durably register BEFORE the single POST. An unknown outcome is never replayed/rekeyed.
userResources.retainResource: async({kind,id,actor,name?,parentId?,key?,operationId?}); resolve matching intent by key and retain accepted ID. Parent retains raw private IDs; public evidence hashes only.
userResources.release: async()->{released:true}; called only after all known Sandboxes retire, child/admission finality is verified, and no create is unresolved.
userResources.finality: async({sandboxId})->{sandbox_id,children_remaining:0,pending_operations:0,cleanup_complete:true}; actual read-only infrastructure observation after public retirement, never a constant result or case oracle.
userResources.navigationReadFault: navigation-tasks only: async({page,method:GET,path:/api/v1/sandboxes,count:1,status:503})->{restore:async()}. Fail one actual matching inventory GET (canonicalize /api/agent-manager alias and ignore query); no success responses or mutation interception. Parent retains cleanup custody before arming, including exceptions.

execution_status: AUTHORED_ONLY: offline contract tests are not live feature PASS. Parent binds primitives and executes on its next frozen runtime; no current campaign hotload.
